Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round eighteen

Mother-of-pearl on a dark disc

Round seventeen’s Akoya and Rose mother-of-pearl, set on a near-black disc, as the earlier Inside Out logo sat in its disc. Clasped only from here on. For each colourway: the mark roomy in the disc, tight to it, breaking out past the edge, and with a fine pearl ring inside the rim. The disc is the same near-black on both palettes, so the pearl colours read the same. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.
